{"scxml": "<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="PingPong" initial="deciding">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="turn" expr="0"/>
    <data id="input" expr="null"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="deciding">
    <transition cond="input !== null && input.parent.data.content === 'ping'" target="answered"/>
    <transition target="declined"/>
  </state>
  <final id="answered">
    <donedata>
      <content expr="({turn: turn, handled: true, selected: [{event: 'bot.ability.communication.respond', target: 'communication', data: {parts: [{words: 'pong'}]}, reason: 'ping'}]})"/>
    </donedata>
  </final>
  <final id="declined">
    <donedata>
      <content expr="({turn: turn, handled: false, selected: []})"/>
    </donedata>
  </final>
</scxml>", "schemas": {"$defs": {}}, "script": "", "tests": [{"name": "answers its turn", "events": [], "settle_ms": 2000, "expect_events": [], "expect_done": true}]}
